analysis.recent_context: Sunday 2026-07-06 at 22:00 SGT. Yesterday (Jul 5) was a 402-message Telegram deep-dive on Payntra bugs (forgot-password SMTP failure + logout broken in browser). Root cause turned out to be three-headed: Docker bridge MTU 1500 fragmented TLS handshakes against host MTU 1400, env_file wasn't mounted into the app container so SMTP creds were empty, and the db service wasn't on the same payntra-net as the app so the host `db` didn't resolve. All three fixed in one docker-compose.yml + .env edit cycle, webhooks redeployed, SMTP works (POST /api/auth/forgot-password returns ok:true, email delivered), logout + per-row delete + add-to-ledger all live, Playwright 8/8 against the same build. non_negotiable.title: Update the Payntra README to reflect the real SMTP/MTU root cause
non_negotiable.reason: The current README documents the SMTP blocker as 'outbound TLS handshake to mail.cyberslide.net:465/587 times out from dev VPS IP — use Resend/Postmark/SES' — but that's wrong. The real root cause was three-headed (Docker MTU 1500 → 1400, env_file missing in app container, db service not on same network), and ALL three are fixed in docker-compose.yml. If the next person (you, in 3 months, or me, on a re-invite) hits a 'SMTP not working' edge case, they'll re-investigate the wrong hypothesis for hours. Payntra is the first real project on the new VPS pipeline — the README is the only durable record of WHY the deploy was set up the way it is. Update it today while the muscle memory is fresh.
non_negotiable.action: Open /root/projects/payntra/README.md (or /root/.hermes/projects/payntra if there's a local mirror). Find the 'SMTP Blocker' or 'Outbound Email' section. Replace the 'cloud VPS IP blocked, swap to Resend/Postmark/SES' guidance with the actual fix: (1) Docker bridge MTU forced to 1400 via driver_opts: com.docker.network.driver.mtu: '1400' in the payntra-net network, (2) env_file: .env mounted on BOTH app and db services, (3) db service attached to payntra-net so the `db` host resolves. Include the verification commands: docker exec payntra-app node -e 'nodemailer.createTransport(...).verify()' and curl -X POST https://payntra.terrybot.top/api/auth/forgot-password. Also re-run the Playwright e2e suite (npx playwright test) against the live build to confirm the SMTP/MTU fixes didn't regress anything that was passing before. 20 minutes of work, gates all future Payntra debugging from going down the wrong path again.
